title: Navigation
hint: Choose which pages appear and drag their handles to reorder them, or use the arrows. The first four visible pages appear in the mobile bar; the rest are under More. Settings is always available. Save to apply across your devices. Hiding a page only removes its navigation link; it does not restrict access.
dragInstructions: Press Space to pick up an entry. Use the arrow keys to move it. Press Space again to drop it, or Escape to cancel.
